source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of why terms of use matter (PDF 176-177).

items: Huqooq ka tahaffuz: shiqein privacy, service ke darje aur nuqsan ki talafi jaise huqooq batati hain; Foodpanda jaisi delivery service batati hai ke ghalat ya der se order par kya hoga.

Wazahat aur shaffafiyat: users jante hain ke service kya deti hai, kin sharait par aur kya mana hai; mobile payment service len den ki had, fees aur ghair mujaz len den ki shikayat ka tareeqa batati hai.
Qanooni hifazat: karobar ghalat istemal se bachte hain; online taleemi platform ijazat ke baghair course ka mawad share karna mana kar sakta hai.

blocks.text: Kuch platforms apni shiqein aksar badalte hain, is liye waqtan fawaqtan dekhte rahein (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Users ke liye terms of use samajhna kyun zaroori hai (short question 1)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh users ko un ke huqooq (privacy, service ka darja, shikayat ka tareeqa), kya jaiz aur kya najaiz, un ke data ka istemal aur kaunsi fees ya hadein lagu hain batate hain, ta ke woh ghair mutawaqqo baaton, ghalat istemal aur qanooni pareshani se bachein aur faisla kar sakein ke service istemal karein ya nahi.

items: Terms of use huqooq bachate, wazahat dete aur karobar ko qanooni hifazat dete hain.
